# Gentle King

> Gentle King (gentleking.org) is a free ministry site, confessionally Reformed and Presbyterian. It sets out the gospel of Jesus Christ, Scripture for grief and other hard hours, help for the fight against sin, Reformed doctrine held to the Westminster Confession of Faith, answers to objections against Christianity, and Sojourner, a free Bible study app for the browser, Windows, and Linux.

The site is written by Colt, a layman in the Reformed Presbyterian tradition. He is not a pastor or an elder, and the site is no substitute for a local church. Scripture is quoted from the King James Version. The Westminster Standards are quoted from the text of 1647. The writing may be copied and shared freely under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 license. Please do not sell it, and please do not change the words and keep the name on it.

Sojourner 0.4.1 is free Bible study software for Windows 10 and 11 and for Linux, 64-bit, made by the same writer and given away free. On Linux it comes as a .deb for Ubuntu 24.04, Linux Mint 22, and Debian 13 or newer, and as an AppImage for most other systems from 2024 on. It needs no account, works with the network off, and sends no telemetry. The Windows installer is about 594 MB, the .deb about 519 MB, and the AppImage about 626 MB. The same app runs in any modern browser at https://app.gentleking.org/, on phones, tablets, and computers, and can be installed to the home screen as a progressive web app.

Mortify (https://mortify.gentleking.org/) is a free web app by the same writer for putting sin to death by the Spirit. It works in the browser on a phone or a computer, and it needs a free account made with an email address.

In immediate danger, call 911 in the United States. For thoughts of suicide or emotional distress, call or text 988. Anyone being hurt at home can call the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 1-800-799-7233, or text START to 88788. If a child is in immediate danger, call 911. Outside the United States, call the local emergency number. The page If You Are Not Safe (https://gentleking.org/comfort-safety.html) gives these numbers and more.

## The gospel

- [The Gospel of Jesus Christ](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html): What is the gospel? Who God is, what sin has done, how Christ died and rose for sinners, and how you're forgiven and made right with God by faith alone. Its parts are [Come to Him](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#come), [Who God Is](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#god), [What Sin Is and What It Has Done](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#sin), [The Wrath of God and the Judgment to Come](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#wrath), [Jesus Christ, the Gentle King](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#christ), [Grace Alone](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#grace), [Repentance and Faith](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#repentance), [Justification by Faith Alone](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#justification), and [Life After You Believe](https://gentleking.org/gospel.html#new-life).

## Comfort in hard hours

- [Grief and Hard Times](https://gentleking.org/comfort.html): King James Bible verses and plain counsel for grief, the death of a spouse or child, suicide loss, illness, divorce, a prodigal child, depression, and danger. Its parts are [What Are You Facing?](https://gentleking.org/comfort.html#what-happened), [Christ Knows Grief Firsthand](https://gentleking.org/comfort.html#christ-knows), [When You Can't Pray](https://gentleking.org/comfort.html#cannot-pray), [Ask the Church to Help](https://gentleking.org/comfort.html#not-alone), and [Christ Is Offered to You](https://gentleking.org/comfort.html#come).
- [When Someone You Love Has Died](https://gentleking.org/comfort-grief.html): Help after someone dies. Practical support, grief that returns, and KJV Scripture on mourning and the resurrection of believers. Its parts are [When a Date Brings It Back](https://gentleking.org/comfort-grief.html#grief-search) and [After the Visitors Leave](https://gentleking.org/comfort-grief.html#next-steps).
- [When Your Husband or Wife Has Died](https://gentleking.org/comfort-widowed.html): Help for widows and widowers with grief, children, daily tasks, bills, and the Christian hope of resurrection. Its parts are [When you're ready to ask about heaven](https://gentleking.org/comfort-widowed.html#widowed-heaven), [Evenings and Holidays](https://gentleking.org/comfort-widowed.html#widowed-search), and [Bills, Documents, and the House](https://gentleking.org/comfort-widowed.html#next-steps).
- [When Your Child Has Died](https://gentleking.org/comfort-death-of-a-child.html): Care after miscarriage, stillbirth, or a child's death. Grief, self-blame, practical support, and what Scripture teaches about children and salvation. Its parts are [If you lost a baby or a little child](https://gentleking.org/comfort-death-of-a-child.html#baby), [If your baby died before birth](https://gentleking.org/comfort-death-of-a-child.html#before-birth), [If your son or daughter was older](https://gentleking.org/comfort-death-of-a-child.html#older-child), [For every grieving parent](https://gentleking.org/comfort-death-of-a-child.html#every-parent), [When You Blame Yourself](https://gentleking.org/comfort-death-of-a-child.html#child-search), and [Let Others Help You Remember](https://gentleking.org/comfort-death-of-a-child.html#next-steps).
- [When You Fear They Didn't Know Christ](https://gentleking.org/comfort-did-they-know-christ.html): Grieving someone whose faith was uncertain? Scripture on judgment, last-hour mercy, regret, and the limits of what we can know. Its parts are [When You Wish You Had Said More](https://gentleking.org/comfort-did-they-know-christ.html#unsure-search) and [When Others Speak With Certainty](https://gentleking.org/comfort-did-they-know-christ.html#next-steps).
- [When Someone You Love Took Their Own Life](https://gentleking.org/comfort-suicide-loss.html): Support after a death by suicide. Scripture on grief and perseverance, help with painful questions, and routes to urgent care. Its parts are [Questions You May Be Asked](https://gentleking.org/comfort-suicide-loss.html#suicide-loss-search) and [In the Weeks That Follow](https://gentleking.org/comfort-suicide-loss.html#next-steps).
- [When Serious Illness Comes](https://gentleking.org/comfort-illness.html): Help with serious illness, caregiving, and end-of-life questions. Medical care, practical support, prayer, and biblical hope without promises of healing now. Its parts are [When it has gone on for years](https://gentleking.org/comfort-illness.html#long-illness), [If you're caring for someone](https://gentleking.org/comfort-illness.html#caregiver), [If death is near](https://gentleking.org/comfort-illness.html#dying), [When Healing Doesn't Come](https://gentleking.org/comfort-illness.html#illness-search), and [Questions to Bring to an Appointment](https://gentleking.org/comfort-illness.html#next-steps).
- [When Your Marriage Is Breaking](https://gentleking.org/comfort-marriage.html): Help when a marriage breaks. Safety, betrayal, desertion, biblical grounds for divorce, repentance, and care for children. Its parts are [What God has said about divorce](https://gentleking.org/comfort-marriage.html#divorce), [If Someone Pressures You to Reconcile](https://gentleking.org/comfort-marriage.html#marriage-search), [If you're the one who broke faith](https://gentleking.org/comfort-marriage.html#if-it-was-me), [If it's your parents](https://gentleking.org/comfort-marriage.html#parents), and [Counsel Should Hear the Facts](https://gentleking.org/comfort-marriage.html#next-steps).
- [When Your Child Walks Away From the Lord](https://gentleking.org/comfort-prodigal.html): Help when a child rejects the faith. Honest conversation, household safety, boundaries, repentance, and prayer for God's grace. Its parts are [If Your Child Is an Adult](https://gentleking.org/comfort-prodigal.html#prodigal-search) and [If They Ask to Come Home](https://gentleking.org/comfort-prodigal.html#next-steps).
- [When You Lose Your Job or Home](https://gentleking.org/comfort-work-and-home.html): Lost work or housing? Help with immediate needs, assistance, deadlines, and seeking work, with Scripture on provision and the church's care. Its parts are [If You May Lose Your Home](https://gentleking.org/comfort-work-and-home.html#want-search) and [If You Have Lost Your Job](https://gentleking.org/comfort-work-and-home.html#next-steps).
- [When You're Lonely](https://gentleking.org/comfort-loneliness.html): Help for loneliness, isolation, and being overlooked at church. Ways to ask for company and care, with Scripture for single and married readers. Its parts are [God Gives the Lonely a Family](https://gentleking.org/comfort-loneliness.html#families), [If You're Single](https://gentleking.org/comfort-loneliness.html#single), [If You're Married and Alone](https://gentleking.org/comfort-loneliness.html#married-and-alone), [When the Church Has Overlooked You](https://gentleking.org/comfort-loneliness.html#loneliness-search), and [If You Cannot Get to Worship](https://gentleking.org/comfort-loneliness.html#next-steps).
- [When You're Depressed](https://gentleking.org/comfort-depression.html): Depression and Christian faith. Seeking professional care, asking for support, continuing treatment, and reading Scripture without self-diagnosis. Its parts are [When Prayer Feels Beyond You](https://gentleking.org/comfort-depression.html#darkness-search) and [Getting Help and Continuing Care](https://gentleking.org/comfort-depression.html#next-steps).
- [If You're Not Safe](https://gentleking.org/comfort-safety.html): Urgent help in the United States for danger, suicidal thoughts, domestic violence, and child abuse. Safety, reporting, and church care. Its parts are [If you're thinking of ending your life](https://gentleking.org/comfort-safety.html#ending-your-life), [If someone is hurting you](https://gentleking.org/comfort-safety.html#someone-hurting-you), and [If a child is being hurt](https://gentleking.org/comfort-safety.html#child-hurt).

## Fighting sin

- [Struggling With Sin](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html): Worn down by the same sin? Scripture, John Owen, and the Westminster Standards on putting sin to death by the Spirit, and on assurance that rests on Christ. Its parts are [If You're Tired of Losing](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html#tired), [Why Promises to Stop Don't Last](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html#never-empty), [Look to Christ](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html#beholding), [Where to Start](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html#first), [Putting Sin to Death](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html#put-to-death), [Your Part and the Spirit’s Part](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html#the-fight), [Mortify](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html#mortify), [Porn, Adultery, Anger, and Addiction](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html#named), [When You Feel Like Giving Up](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html#ground), [If You've Made Peace With It](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html#at-peace), and [The Fight Will End](https://gentleking.org/struggle.html#until).

## Doctrine

- [What We Believe](https://gentleking.org/doctrine.html): What do Reformed Christians believe? The five solas, the doctrines of grace, covenant theology, and the last things, held to the Westminster Confession. Its one part is [Begin With One Subject](https://gentleking.org/doctrine.html#overview).

## Answers to objections

- [Questions About Christianity](https://gentleking.org/apologetics.html): Honest answers to common objections to Christianity, from God and the Bible to evil and hell, and Scripture for the believer who fears he isn't really saved. Its parts are [Choose Your Question](https://gentleking.org/apologetics.html#two-readers), [For the One Who Objects](https://gentleking.org/apologetics.html#objector), and [Assurance and Doubt](https://gentleking.org/apologetics.html#believer).
- [Is God Real?](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-god.html): Is there no evidence for God? Who made God? Has science replaced him? Every argument against God is made with tools that only work if he is there. Its parts are [There's no evidence for God](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-god.html#no-evidence), [Who made God?](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-god.html#who-made-god), [Science has replaced God](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-god.html#science), [Faith is believing without evidence](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-god.html#faith-and-evidence), and [Examine the Claims](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-god.html#next-steps).
- [Can the Bible Be Trusted?](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-bible.html): Men wrote it, men chose the books, it contradicts itself, it was changed. Plain answers on the authority of the Bible, its canon, and its manuscripts. Its parts are [Men wrote it](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-bible.html#men-wrote-it), [Men chose which books went in](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-bible.html#the-canon), [It contradicts itself](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-bible.html#contradictions), [It has been changed over time](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-bible.html#changed-over-time), [You're arguing in a circle](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-bible.html#circular), [Nobody can take it all literally](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-bible.html#literally), [Read the Accounts for Yourself](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-bible.html#next-steps), and [Check the Manuscript Evidence](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-bible.html#manuscript-sources).
- [Did Jesus Rise From the Dead?](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-resurrection.html): Did Jesus live? Is the resurrection a legend? Did the disciples lie, or were they fooled? The faith rests on an event at a real time and place. Its parts are [He may never have lived](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-resurrection.html#never-lived), [The resurrection is a legend](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-resurrection.html#legend), [The disciples lied, or they were fooled](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-resurrection.html#lied-or-fooled), [Dead men don't rise](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-resurrection.html#dead-men-do-not-rise), [Read the Resurrection Accounts](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-resurrection.html#next-steps), and [Check the Historical Record](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-resurrection.html#historical-record).
- [Why Does God Allow Evil?](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-evil.html): The problem of evil, whether God is to blame, the conquest of Canaan, and slavery in the Bible, answered with care for those who carry a grief of their own. Its parts are [A good and powerful God would stop it](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-evil.html#why-allow-evil), [Then God is to blame](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-evil.html#is-god-to-blame), [The God of the Old Testament is cruel](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-evil.html#old-testament), [The Bible approves of slavery](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-evil.html#slavery), and [Bring the Question to Scripture](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-evil.html#next-steps).
- [Can You Be Good Without God?](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-morality.html): Is morality only evolution or culture? Nearly everyone is sure that some things are really wrong. Very few ask what makes them so. Its parts are [I can be good without God](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-morality.html#good-without-god), [Morality is only evolution or culture](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-morality.html#evolution-or-culture), and [Examine Your Life](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-morality.html#next-steps).
- [Is Hell Fair?](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-hell.html): Would a loving God send anyone to hell? Is forever too long for a short life of sin? Hell is real, and it should never be spoken of lightly or left out. Its parts are [A loving God wouldn't send anyone there](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-hell.html#a-loving-god), [Forever is too long for a short life of sin](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-hell.html#forever), and [Read Christ's Warnings](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-hell.html#next-steps).
- [Is Jesus the Only Way?](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-only-jesus.html): Do all religions lead to God? What about those who never heard? Is it arrogant to say you're right? Why Christians say Jesus is the only way. Its parts are [All religions lead to God](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-only-jesus.html#all-religions), [What about those who never heard?](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-only-jesus.html#never-heard), [It's arrogant to say you're right](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-only-jesus.html#arrogance), and [Consider Christ's Claim](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-only-jesus.html#next-steps).
- [What About the Hypocrites?](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-christians.html): The church is full of hypocrites, and religion has done great harm. Some of the strongest arguments against Christ come from people who carry his name. Its parts are [The church is full of hypocrites](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-christians.html#hypocrites), [Religion has done great harm](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-christians.html#harm), and [Consider the Objection](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-christians.html#next-steps).
- [Is It Fair That God Chooses?](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-election.html): The Bible teaches that God chooses whom he will save. Is that fair, and is there any point in trying? Paul raised the objection himself. Its parts are [If God chooses, how can he blame me?](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-election.html#how-can-he-blame-me), [Then there's no point in trying](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-election.html#no-point-trying), and [Christ's Invitation](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-election.html#next-steps).
- [Am I a Good Person?](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-the-real-objection.html): Every objection has an answer. Jesus said the reason men stay away from him lies somewhere else. The law, the human heart, and the hope for sinners. Its parts are [I'm a good person](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-the-real-objection.html#good-person) and [Then what hope is there for me?](https://gentleking.org/apologetics-the-real-objection.html#what-hope).

## Fear, doubt, and assurance, for believers

- [Am I Really Saved?](https://gentleking.org/assurance-am-i-his.html): Not sure you are saved? Scripture and the Westminster Confession on assurance, weak faith, election, and receiving help without repeated self-checking. Its parts are [I don't know if I'm saved](https://gentleking.org/assurance-am-i-his.html#not-sure), [Maybe my faith was never real](https://gentleking.org/assurance-am-i-his.html#never-real), [I'm afraid I wasn't chosen](https://gentleking.org/assurance-am-i-his.html#not-chosen), and [Return to Christ's Promises](https://gentleking.org/assurance-am-i-his.html#next-steps).
- [When the Same Sin Keeps Coming Back](https://gentleking.org/assurance-remaining-sin.html): Recurring sin, repentance, and forgiveness. Biblical warnings against excusing sin alongside Christ's promise of pardon to those who turn to him. Its parts are [I keep going back to the same sin](https://gentleking.org/assurance-remaining-sin.html#same-sin), [What I did is too great to forgive](https://gentleking.org/assurance-remaining-sin.html#too-great), [He must be tired of forgiving me](https://gentleking.org/assurance-remaining-sin.html#tired-of-forgiving), and [When the Sin Returns](https://gentleking.org/assurance-remaining-sin.html#next-steps).
- [The Unpardonable Sin and Falling Away](https://gentleking.org/assurance-night-fears.html): The unpardonable sin, Hebrews 6 and 10, and fear of losing salvation. Read warnings in context without using repeated prayer as a test. Its parts are [I think I've committed the unpardonable sin](https://gentleking.org/assurance-night-fears.html#unpardonable-sin), [Hebrews 6 and 10 frighten me](https://gentleking.org/assurance-night-fears.html#hebrews-6-and-10), [I might lose my salvation](https://gentleking.org/assurance-night-fears.html#losing-salvation), and [When You Fear Falling Away](https://gentleking.org/assurance-night-fears.html#next-steps).
- [When God Feels Far](https://gentleking.org/assurance-god-feels-far.html): When God feels far away. Scripture on assurance, known sin, prayer, and receiving pastoral and medical care during spiritual distress. Its parts are [I've prayed, but God still feels far away](https://gentleking.org/assurance-god-feels-far.html#silence), [Has God withdrawn his love from me?](https://gentleking.org/assurance-god-feels-far.html#withdrawn), [What if my sin has brought this darkness?](https://gentleking.org/assurance-god-feels-far.html#sin), [I've repented. Why hasn't the comfort returned?](https://gentleking.org/assurance-god-feels-far.html#still-dark), [How do I seek him while I feel nothing?](https://gentleking.org/assurance-god-feels-far.html#means), [What about exhaustion, grief, or illness?](https://gentleking.org/assurance-god-feels-far.html#body), and [What to do now](https://gentleking.org/assurance-god-feels-far.html#next-steps).
- [Doubts and Unwanted Thoughts](https://gentleking.org/assurance-doubts-and-thoughts.html): Questions about Christianity and distressing unwanted thoughts. Biblical counsel, the difference between temptation and consent, and professional assessment. Its parts are [Sometimes I wonder if any of it's true](https://gentleking.org/assurance-doubts-and-thoughts.html#is-it-true), [I have thoughts I would never choose](https://gentleking.org/assurance-doubts-and-thoughts.html#unwanted-thoughts), and [When Doubts Keep Returning](https://gentleking.org/assurance-doubts-and-thoughts.html#next-steps).
- [Is God Punishing Me?](https://gentleking.org/assurance-affliction.html): Does suffering mean God is punishing you? Romans 8, Hebrews 12, and the difference between fatherly discipline and condemnation. Its parts are [It feels as if God is against me](https://gentleking.org/assurance-affliction.html#god-against-me), [I think he is punishing me](https://gentleking.org/assurance-affliction.html#punishment), and [While You Endure This](https://gentleking.org/assurance-affliction.html#next-steps).
- [Afraid of Dying](https://gentleking.org/assurance-death.html): Fear of death, practical preparation, and the Christian hope. Care-team questions, local advice about documents, and Scripture on resurrection. Its one part is [When Death Frightens You](https://gentleking.org/assurance-death.html#next-steps).
- [Will God Keep Me to the End?](https://gentleking.org/assurance-kept.html): How Christ keeps believers to the end. Perseverance, assurance, the Lord's Table, prayer, and access to church care during illness or disability.

## Practical guides

- [Plain Guides for the Christian Life](https://gentleking.org/guides.html): What the Bible says about marriage, sex, abortion, IVF, money, alcohol, gambling, tattoos, government, and death, and practical guides for prayer and church. Its one part is [About These Guides](https://gentleking.org/guides.html#about-these).
- [How to Pray](https://gentleking.org/guide-prayer.html): How to pray through Christ, use the Lord’s Prayer, confess sin, give thanks, and form a habit that accounts for illness and daily responsibilities. Its parts are [What Prayer Is](https://gentleking.org/guide-prayer.html#what-prayer-is), [How to Pray](https://gentleking.org/guide-prayer.html#how), [Use the Lord’s Prayer as the Pattern](https://gentleking.org/guide-prayer.html#lords-prayer), [What Displeases God in Prayer](https://gentleking.org/guide-prayer.html#what-to-avoid), and [Make It a Habit](https://gentleking.org/guide-prayer.html#habits).
- [How to Read the Bible](https://gentleking.org/guide-bible-reading.html): How to read the Bible for yourself with prayer and understanding, where a new reader should start, a plan for the whole Bible, and helps worth having. Its parts are [Why Read It Yourself](https://gentleking.org/guide-bible-reading.html#why), [How to Read It](https://gentleking.org/guide-bible-reading.html#how), [Where to Start](https://gentleking.org/guide-bible-reading.html#where), and [Helps Worth Having](https://gentleking.org/guide-bible-reading.html#helps).
- [How to Meditate on and Memorize Scripture](https://gentleking.org/guide-meditation.html): How to meditate on Scripture the biblical way, not by emptying the mind, with a simple method for one verse and a plan to memorize in small moments. Its parts are [What Meditation Is and Isn't](https://gentleking.org/guide-meditation.html#what-it-is), [The Tree by the Rivers](https://gentleking.org/guide-meditation.html#the-tree), [How to Meditate on a Verse](https://gentleking.org/guide-meditation.html#how), [Why and How to Memorize](https://gentleking.org/guide-meditation.html#memorize), [Use the Small Moments](https://gentleking.org/guide-meditation.html#small-moments), and [This Week](https://gentleking.org/guide-meditation.html#this-week).
- [How to Examine Yourself](https://gentleking.org/guide-examine-yourself.html): How to examine yourself as Scripture commands, with questions from the Larger Catechism, a short daily habit, and a caution for the anxious. Its parts are [Why Examine Yourself](https://gentleking.org/guide-examine-yourself.html#why), [Look at Christ First](https://gentleking.org/guide-examine-yourself.html#first), [Questions to Ask](https://gentleking.org/guide-examine-yourself.html#questions), [How to Do It](https://gentleking.org/guide-examine-yourself.html#how), and [Two Cautions](https://gentleking.org/guide-examine-yourself.html#cautions).
- [How to Repent](https://gentleking.org/guide-repentance.html): How to repent of sin, by the Shorter Catechism. Godly sorrow, confessing sins by name, restitution, and the Father who runs to meet the prodigal. Its parts are [What Repentance Is](https://gentleking.org/guide-repentance.html#what), [Two Kinds of Sorrow](https://gentleking.org/guide-repentance.html#sorrow), [Repent of Sins by Name](https://gentleking.org/guide-repentance.html#by-name), [Coming Home, and Coming Home Again](https://gentleking.org/guide-repentance.html#again), and [Steps for Today](https://gentleking.org/guide-repentance.html#steps).
- [The Ten Commandments for a Believer](https://gentleking.org/guide-ten-commandments.html): Why a Christian keeps the Ten Commandments, how to read them, what each one requires and forbids by the Shorter Catechism, and how to use them. Its parts are [Why a Believer Keeps the Law](https://gentleking.org/guide-ten-commandments.html#why-keep), [How to Read Them](https://gentleking.org/guide-ten-commandments.html#rules), [Each Commandment in Plain Words](https://gentleking.org/guide-ten-commandments.html#each), and [How to Use Them This Week](https://gentleking.org/guide-ten-commandments.html#use).
- [How God Wants to Be Worshiped](https://gentleking.org/guide-worship.html): Reformed Presbyterian public worship, the regulative principle, elements and circumstances, psalm singing, and practical guidance for visitors. - [What the Bible Says About Government](https://gentleking.org/guide-government.html): What the Bible says about government. Rulers as God’s ministers, the kingship of Christ over nations, taxes, and obeying God rather than men. Its parts are [Government Is God’s Ordinance](https://gentleking.org/guide-government.html#ordinance), [Christ Is King of Kings](https://gentleking.org/guide-government.html#king), [The Magistrate's Duty Toward True Religion](https://gentleking.org/guide-government.html#limits), [Honor, Pray, Pay, and Obey](https://gentleking.org/guide-government.html#duty), [When We Must Obey God Rather Than Men](https://gentleking.org/guide-government.html#obey-god), [The Christian Citizen](https://gentleking.org/guide-government.html#citizen), [The Throne That Matters Most](https://gentleking.org/guide-government.html#throne), and [What Christians Should Do](https://gentleking.org/guide-government.html#what-to-do).
- [What the Bible Says About Death, Burial, and Cremation](https://gentleking.org/guide-death.html): What the Bible says about death. What happens when we die, the resurrection of the body, burial and cremation, euthanasia, and preparing to die. Its parts are [What Death Is](https://gentleking.org/guide-death.html#enemy), [What Happens When We Die](https://gentleking.org/guide-death.html#after-death), [The Resurrection of the Body](https://gentleking.org/guide-death.html#resurrection), [Burial in Scripture](https://gentleking.org/guide-death.html#burial), [What About Cremation](https://gentleking.org/guide-death.html#cremation), [Choices at the End of Life](https://gentleking.org/guide-death.html#end-of-life), and [Preparing to Die](https://gentleking.org/guide-death.html#prepare).
- [Church Membership](https://gentleking.org/guide-church-membership.html): How to seek church membership, understand vows, meet with elders, distinguish communicant membership, and receive accountable pastoral care. Its parts are [Why Belong to a Congregation?](https://gentleking.org/guide-church-membership.html#belongs), [What Is Communicant Membership?](https://gentleking.org/guide-church-membership.html#communicant), [Why Meet With the Elders?](https://gentleking.org/guide-church-membership.html#elders), [Understand Your Promises](https://gentleking.org/guide-church-membership.html#vows), and [Life After Joining](https://gentleking.org/guide-church-membership.html#life).
- [Visiting and Joining an RP Church](https://gentleking.org/guide-joining-rpc.html): Visiting and joining an RPCNA congregation, worship, communion admission, baptism, membership conversations, and current denominational requirements. Its parts are [Your First Lord's Day](https://gentleking.org/guide-joining-rpc.html#visit), [Which Standards Should You Read?](https://gentleking.org/guide-joining-rpc.html#standards), [The Membership Conversation](https://gentleking.org/guide-joining-rpc.html#interview), [What About Your Spouse and Children?](https://gentleking.org/guide-joining-rpc.html#family), and [After You're Received](https://gentleking.org/guide-joining-rpc.html#after).

## Teachers weighed

- [Teacher Reviews](https://gentleking.org/teachers.html): Popular preachers weighed by Scripture and the Westminster Confession, from their own words. Fair, sourced discernment reports to read or download. Its parts are [Why This Page Is Here](https://gentleking.org/teachers.html#why), [How Each Teacher Is Weighed](https://gentleking.org/teachers.html#how), [The Reports](https://gentleking.org/teachers.html#reports), and [In What Spirit to Use These](https://gentleking.org/teachers.html#spirit).
- [Philip Anthony Mitchell](https://gentleking.org/teacher-philip-anthony-mitchell.html): Philip Anthony Mitchell of 2819 Church weighed by Scripture and the Westminster Confession. His Christology, words from God, ACCESS, and fasting. Its parts are [The Short Answer](https://gentleking.org/teacher-philip-anthony-mitchell.html#short-answer), [How This Report Was Made](https://gentleking.org/teacher-philip-anthony-mitchell.html#method), [Who He Is](https://gentleking.org/teacher-philip-anthony-mitchell.html#who), [The ACCESS Gatherings](https://gentleking.org/teacher-philip-anthony-mitchell.html#access), [What He Gets Right](https://gentleking.org/teacher-philip-anthony-mitchell.html#right), [The Person of Christ](https://gentleking.org/teacher-philip-anthony-mitchell.html#christ), [Claims of Direct Words From God](https://gentleking.org/teacher-philip-anthony-mitchell.html#revelation), [Prayer, Portals, and a Demand on God](https://gentleking.org/teacher-philip-anthony-mitchell.html#prayer), [Fasting and Promises God Did Not Make](https://gentleking.org/teacher-philip-anthony-mitchell.html#fasting), [Signs, Tongues, and Healing Reports](https://gentleking.org/teacher-philip-anthony-mitchell.html#gifts), [Assurance and Perseverance](https://gentleking.org/teacher-philip-anthony-mitchell.html#assurance), [Handling the Text](https://gentleking.org/teacher-philip-anthony-mitchell.html#text), [Money, Tickets, and Answering Critics](https://gentleking.org/teacher-philip-anthony-mitchell.html#money), [Training, Associations, and Influences](https://gentleking.org/teacher-philip-anthony-mitchell.html#influences), [The Church and Its Government](https://gentleking.org/teacher-philip-anthony-mitchell.html#church), [Worship and the Danger of Idolizing a Preacher](https://gentleking.org/teacher-philip-anthony-mitchell.html#worship), [What This Report Does Not Charge](https://gentleking.org/teacher-philip-anthony-mitchell.html#not-charged), [Summary of Findings](https://gentleking.org/teacher-philip-anthony-mitchell.html#findings), [Counsel for the Saints](https://gentleking.org/teacher-philip-anthony-mitchell.html#counsel), and [Sources](https://gentleking.org/teacher-philip-anthony-mitchell.html#sources).

## Sojourner, a free Bible study app

- [Sojourner](https://gentleking.org/sojourner.html): Free Bible study for phone, tablet, and computer. Thirteen translations, the Hebrew and Greek, Matthew Henry, Calvin, and the Westminster Standards. Its parts are [What Sojourner Is](https://gentleking.org/sojourner.html#what), [Main Features](https://gentleking.org/sojourner.html#features), [Private and Offline](https://gentleking.org/sojourner.html#offline), [Get Sojourner](https://gentleking.org/sojourner.html#get-it), [Free Bible Software for Your Phone and Computer](https://gentleking.org/sojourner.html#free-bible-software), [What It Doesn't Have](https://gentleking.org/sojourner.html#limits), [More About Sojourner](https://gentleking.org/sojourner.html#more), and [Feedback](https://gentleking.org/sojourner.html#feedback).
- [Everything Sojourner Does](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-features.html): Everything Sojourner does, with pictures. Linked panes, Color text, the Hebrew and Greek, the atlas and timeline, search, sermons, and family worship. Its parts are [Panes That Follow Each Other](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-features.html#panes), [Color Text](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-features.html#color-text), [Greek and Hebrew for Beginners](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-features.html#languages), [People, Places, and Maps](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-features.html#maps), [One Search Box](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-features.html#search), [Reading](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-features.html#reading), [Private Notes](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-features.html#notes), [Preparing and Preaching](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-features.html#sermons), [The Today Page](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-features.html#devotion), and [Family Worship](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-features.html#family).
- [Sojourner on Your Phone](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-web.html): A free Bible study app for iPhone, Android, iPad, and Mac, in the browser. The commentaries, confessions, Greek and Hebrew, with no account and no store. Its parts are [The Same Sojourner, Anywhere](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-web.html#what), [Putting It on Your Home Screen](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-web.html#home-screen), [The Books, and Using It Offline](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-web.html#books), [Your Notes Stay on Your Device](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-web.html#your-data), [What the Web Version Leaves Out](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-web.html#differences), and [Try It Now](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-web.html#open).
- [What Comes With Sojourner](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-library.html): The Bibles, Hebrew and Greek texts, lexicons, commentaries, Westminster Standards, and book shelves that come with Sojourner, and where each one came from. Its parts are [What Is Included](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-library.html#library), [How Much Is in There](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-library.html#reference), [Add-On Books and Your Own](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-library.html#shelves), and [Where the Texts Came From](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-library.html#credits).
- [Installing and Updating](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-install.html): Installing Sojourner on Windows or Linux, the Windows warning, updating without losing your notes, and adding the book shelves and map packs. Its parts are [Installing It](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-install.html#install), [Two Things to Know First](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-install.html#before-you-install), [Updating](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-install.html#updating), [Adding Books and Maps](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-install.html#shelves), and [Bug Reports and Corrections](https://gentleking.org/sojourner-install.html#trouble).
- [Open Sojourner in the browser](https://app.gentleking.org/): The web app, for any device
- [Download Sojourner](https://github.com/z3r0Colt/sojourner/releases): The Windows installer, the Linux .deb and AppImage, and the four optional book shelves, on GitHub

## Mortify, a free app for the fight against sin

- [Mortify](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html): Mortify is a free app for putting sin to death by the Spirit. Flee in temptation, a morning reading, an evening examination, and help after a fall. Its parts are [Open Mortify](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html#open), [Help to Put Sin to Death by the Spirit](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html#what), [When You're Tempted](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html#flee), [When You've Fallen](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html#fallen), [Morning and Evening](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html#daily), [Fifteen Sins by Name](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html#battles), [Accountability With Friends From Church](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html#brethren), [Private by Design](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html#private), [What It Will Ask of You](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html#begin), [What It's Not](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html#not), and [Contact Me](https://gentleking.org/mortify.html#questions).
- [Open Mortify](https://mortify.gentleking.org/): The app itself, in the browser

## About the site

- [About Gentle King](https://gentleking.org/about.html): Gentle King is written by Colt, a layman in the Reformed Presbyterian tradition who also made Sojourner. What is believed here, and how to get in touch. Its parts are [What This Is](https://gentleking.org/about.html#what-this-is), [Who I Am](https://gentleking.org/about.html#who), [What I Believe](https://gentleking.org/about.html#what-i-believe), [How to Get in Touch](https://gentleking.org/about.html#contact), and [A Word to You](https://gentleking.org/about.html#a-word).
